Exchanges are free within 30 days of delivery, the new pair is handed over when the old one is picked up (usually within 3–5 business days), the tags must still be attached, and each item can be exchanged only once.

items.query: How much does shipping cost for an order within India?
items.reference: Standard shipping is free on orders of ₹499 and above (after discounts); orders below ₹499 pay ₹49. ShopNest Plus members get free standard shipping on every order.

items.query: How much does shipping cost for an order to Singapore?
items.reference: Shipping to Singapore costs ₹1,499 per order for parcels up to 5 kg, plus ₹400 for each extra kg, and takes 7–14 business days. Customs duties and import taxes are paid by the recipient.
